subject: Pricing & next steps — committed-use + startup discount
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@stratus.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:14:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing & next steps — committed-use + startup discount

Hi Alice — thanks for a great discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

Summary of needs
- Primary workload: customer-facing summarization + contextual search (avg response length ~120 tokens).
- Expected steady-state volume: 80–120M tokens/month, with spikes up to ~200M in quarter-end events.
- Latency SLO: 300–500ms p95 per request.
- Security: SOC2 required; will need audit evidence and IP whitelisting.

Cost / pricing notes we covered
- You indicated a target blended $$ around $1,200 per 1M tokens (target $/1M tokens).
- Current internal budget range: $12k–$30k/mo depending on committed term and discounts.

Proposed commercial options (high level)
1) Startup program (6–12 month): 50% off hosted list rates for first $1M tokens/month equivalent for qualifying startups + onboarding credits.
2) Committed-use tiers: 3-month ramp to committed baseline; example pricing tiers attached (see "Redwood_CommittedUse_Tiers_v3.xlsx").
3) Multi-year incentive: additional 10% off list for a 2-year committed use with annual invoicing and a 6% prepayment option.

Next steps
- I will send a proposed committed-use worksheet + sample SOW for your procurement (attached).
- If this looks good, can you confirm the target committed monthly token baseline (a single number from the 80–120M range) and preferred contract term (12/24 months)?
- We'll loop in Legal/Finance for a standard MSA and scope, and Ben will run final pricing approval.

Attachments: Redwood_CommittedUse_Tiers_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), Startup_Discount_SOW.pdf (pdf)

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com

From: Alice Nguyen <alice@stratus.ai>

Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing & next steps — committed-use + startup discount

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. A couple clarifications: 

- Token baseline: we want to start with a 90M tokens/month committed baseline and re-evaluate after 3 months. We expect this to grow to ~150M by Q2 if things go well.
- Budget: the $12k–$30k/mo range is for year 1 — realistically we can stretch to $20k/mo if discounts or credits are included early.
- Target $/1M: the $1,200/1M target is aspirational; acceptable if there are performance guarantees or higher discounts for larger committed tiers.

Procurement asks:
- Can you provide a sample SOW and a short summary of billing cadence (monthly vs annual) + any prepayment discounts?
- Compliance: can we get a SOC2 cert copy and an engineer contact for network/IP whitelisting?

Happy to hop on a 15-min call to confirm the committed baseline later this week.

Best,
Alice
Head of ML Ops | StratusAI
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@stratus.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing & next steps — committed-use + startup discount

Thanks Alice — great, 90M as a starting committed baseline makes sense. A few follow-ups and a concrete pricing example so your procurement team has numbers to work with: 

Concrete example (90M committed baseline, 12-month term) — hosted API model, blended unit economics:
- List rate (unrestricted): $2,400 per 1M tokens
- Startup program discount (qualifies): 50% off list for first 6 months on up to $1M tokens/month equivalent (we'd apply credits to early usage; reduces your effective blended rate in months 1–6)
- Committed-use discount: for 90M baseline we can offer ~60% off list (post-startup discount window) which equates to approx $960 per 1M tokens blended after startup credits expire.
- Multi-year incentive (optional): additional 8% off if you commit to 24 months and agree to annual invoicing with a 6% prepayment option.

Example blended math (illustrative):
- Months 1–6: heavy startup credits applied -> effective $600/1M for months 1–6 on the first $1M/month tranche, other consumption at committed rate.
- Months 7–12: committed rate ~ $960/1M -> over 12 months the blended falls between ~$780–$900/1M depending on overages.

Notes on overages and spikes:
- Spikes above committed baseline are billed at committed uplift rates (we can cap spike pricing for runway months if needed).
- We can include a rollback clause in month 4 if growth is materially below baseline (protects both parties).

Next steps I will take this to pricing and legal for a short form SOW and get a DocuSign link ready. Ben, LMK if these discount levels are OK to approve or if you want a quick calibration call.

Marissa
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
